description: This is a server-side JavaScript file for a SvelteKit project managing tasks and boards in a Django backend. It includes a page load function to fetch board and column data, and several action handlers for creating, updating, deleting, and moving tasks and columns, interfacing with external Django API endpoints.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches detailed board information, columns, and associated tasks from the API, and formats them for client-side rendering.

methods.name: createColumn
methods.description: Creates a new column in the specified board via POST request.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task within a specified column via POST request.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates task details or moves it between columns using PATCH dynamically based on form data.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a specific task identified by taskId.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Moves a task to a different column, updating its order and column ID.
